title: Quality curtains
text: Quality curtains. Very happy with these curtians. Took them out of the packaging, hung them up, steamed them a little and they looked great. Nice material and color.

product_metadata.title: H.VERSAILTEX Linen Blackout Curtain 84 Inches Long for Bedroom/Living Room Thermal Insulated Grommet Linen Look Curtain Drapes Primitive Textured Burlap Effect Window Drapes 1 Panel - Taupe

LIGHT BLOCKING: This elegant window panel is crafted from rich faux linen textured fabric, inner woven construction features natural blackout effect, definitely block out 85% or more sun light and prevent harmful UV ray, this opaque piece totally darken your room, reduce the noise and gives you 100% privacy

ENERGY EFFICIENT: This magic window covering is perfect on thermal insulated, energy saving and balance the temperature. Efficiently prevents cold or heat transfer from outside, blocks drafts in cold months and keeps warm air out in the summer. Great for letting you sleep sweetly on weekend mornings and vacation days

UNIQUE DECOR: Add a touch of classic style to your home with this natural solid-hued linen curtain panel, then arrange a clean-lined writing desk and tufted armchair nearby for a cohesive aesthetic, refresh and brighten your space, adorn well for your home, office, apartment, business, and more
